risk_note: RV2 (orders/**, platform/events; attribution: a blacklist hit voids an uncredited order). Attribution pipeline step ③ (BR-ATTR-26, order of BR-ATTR-01): runs after the user step in the same per-order advisory-lock transaction, for unattributed orders too, through risk's order blocklist ports (B1-09a): an uncredited hit voids through rebate.onBlacklistHit (R6, settlement), a credited hit records manual_review only and enqueues order.blacklist_hit_after_credit (registered at its 02 §11 position) once per order, VOID / CLAWED_BACK writes nothing; without the rebate port or the event bus a hit records manual_review with a P1 alert; an order voided by the blacklist gets no commission snapshot nor snapshot retry (BR-ATTR-01 ⑥, confirmed by the money review). The worker runtime takes optional blocklist and suffix-switch ports (switch default off, 08). Not in this task (followups): app.module wiring of risk's ports, settlement's onBlacklistHit, the config-registry entry of attr.blacklist.order_suffix_void_enabled, and risk recordHit not upgrading manual_review to void_commission (B1-09a, proposed B1-09ab). Codex was unavailable until 10-30, so the rule tests were written and the money review run by fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
